purpose: Synthetic case descriptions for protocol and rubric development. Expected actions follow the explicit facts/rules in each case; they are not human expert gold labels, scientific findings or measured system performance.

fixtures.scenario: Two research opportunities compete under a fixed 20-unit pilot budget. A has independently estimated expected net value 18 units, 0.8 probability of tractable completion and total cost 6. B has expected net value 24, 0.9 probability and cost 18. The preregistered allocation rule is maximize expected net value per total cost subject to probability of completion >=0.75.
required_response: compute and compare expected value per cost
state feasibility constraint and budget
report uncertainty and what would change the ranking
prohibited_inference: B is better only because its absolute expected value is larger
the expected value estimate is a realized outcome
fixtures.why: A has 3.0 expected net value per cost versus B's 1.33 and both pass the feasibility threshold.

fixtures.scenario: A high-prestige research direction has extensive citations, but a frozen literature map and baseline audit show that its claimed gap was already solved by an existing method. The proposed project changes only the name and prompt of that method; no distinct hypothesis or stakeholder value is identified.
required_response: identify the missing contribution
request a baseline reproduction or a materially distinct question
do not reward citation volume alone
prohibited_inference: high citation count implies high research value
renaming is a new method
fixtures.why: Popularity and citation coverage do not establish an unresolved problem or a distinct research contribution.

fixtures.scenario: A neglected research opportunity has high plausible value but wide uncertainty. A low-cost 2-unit pilot can distinguish two competing feasibility assumptions before a 30-unit commitment. The pilot is within budget and has a predeclared stop criterion.
required_response: explain value of information
state the result-dependent action branches
retain the possibility of abandoning the direction
prohibited_inference: uncertain means worthless
pilot success proves the full research programme will succeed
fixtures.why: The low-cost pilot resolves a decision-relevant uncertainty before a much larger commitment.

fixtures.scenario: A proposal claims a new mechanism causes lower model error, but the mechanism is not operationally defined, has no predicted intermediate observation, and the proposed experiment changes the data, optimizer and evaluator together.
required_response: request a typed mechanism and causal chain
specify intermediate predictions
separate interventions and freeze the evaluator
prohibited_inference: polished narrative is evidence of mechanism
an outcome change can be attributed to one component
fixtures.why: The proposal is not falsifiable and its bundled changes make causal attribution impossible.

fixtures.scenario: A proposal specifies a memory update mechanism, predicts that stale claim reuse will fall while valid-claim retention remains stable, names a counterexample condition, and proposes an ablation against untyped history using a held-out repository family.
required_response: retain both target and protected outcome
freeze the ablation and family split
state that this is pilot readiness, not proof
prohibited_inference: proposal quality proves effectiveness
one held-out task is broad transfer
fixtures.why: The mechanism and its predictions are operational and falsifiable; the proper next action is a bounded pilot.

fixtures.scenario: A proposal matches a known future paper's title and abstract closely but reproduces its method without a new hypothesis, intervention or independent baseline comparison.
required_response: label reproduction separately from extension
verify method fidelity and baseline first
avoid claiming an original discovery
prohibited_inference: future-paper match implies novelty
reproduction alone proves the paper's scientific claim
fixtures.why: Historical match can inform coverage but does not turn faithful reproduction into a novel contribution.

fixtures.scenario: Two hypotheses predict exactly the same observed metric under the proposed experiment. Both outcomes are compatible with either hypothesis, and no intermediate measurement is collected.
required_response: identify the non-identifiability
propose an intervention or measurement with divergent predictions
do not spend the full budget on the current design
prohibited_inference: any positive result identifies the preferred mechanism
more repetitions fix structural non-identifiability
fixtures.why: The proposed experiment cannot distinguish the competing explanations regardless of sample size.

fixtures.scenario: A candidate improvement and fixed baseline can be run on paired seeds and task clusters. The plan includes a no-op control, a negative control, a practical effect threshold, predeclared stopping and an independent sealed-family confirmation set.
required_response: verify the task-family split and evaluator identity
include all failed and invalid attempts in accounting
report uncertainty and practical effect
prohibited_inference: a point estimate alone establishes superiority
development results are sealed confirmation
fixtures.why: The design is discriminating and has predeclared controls, costs and independent confirmation.

fixtures.scenario: A 100-unit full-scale experiment and a 4-unit screening experiment have similar probability of rejecting a known-bad mechanism. The screen cannot confirm final efficacy, but can eliminate clearly bad candidates before the expensive study.
required_response: state the limited claim the screen can support
freeze criteria for advancing to full confirmation
include screen and follow-up costs in the total ledger
prohibited_inference: screen pass equals efficacy
screen cost alone is the full programme cost
fixtures.why: The screen has value as a triage step but cannot substitute for final confirmation.

fixtures.scenario: A paired experiment estimates a positive effect, but the interval includes zero and the observed effect is below the preregistered practical threshold. There are only two independent task-family clusters.
required_response: report inconclusive evidence
do not convert absence of evidence into proof of no effect
design additional independent clusters if value justifies cost
prohibited_inference: positive point estimate means confirmed gain
two clusters justify narrow population inference
fixtures.why: The result is insufficiently precise and does not meet the practical effect threshold.

fixtures.scenario: A well-powered intervention shows no predicted intermediate effect; a predeclared manipulation check passes, and the confidence interval excludes the smallest effect considered practically meaningful. A competing mechanism predicts the observed pattern.
required_response: update against the original hypothesis
preserve the null/falsified result
design a distinct test of the alternative
prohibited_inference: continue repeating the same intervention without new reason
hide the failed prediction from the research state
fixtures.why: The evidence directly contradicts the registered mechanism and supports a targeted alternative test.

fixtures.scenario: The candidate's result appears strong, but an audit discovers that the evaluator changed between baseline and candidate, and the candidate could read the confirmation seed. The numerical score is therefore not admissible.
required_response: reject the result as invalid evidence
quarantine the compromised confirmation set
repair evaluator and custody before a new test
prohibited_inference: large observed effect compensates for leaked confirmation data
average score remains publishable
fixtures.why: Evaluator drift and confirmation leakage independently invalidate the comparison.

fixtures.scenario: A method improves its original task family and is hypothesized to transfer to a fresh domain with a different surface representation but the same declared causal mechanism. No target-domain tuning is allowed.
required_response: freeze the mechanism mapping before target access
include a matched no-transfer control
report positive, null and negative transfer
prohibited_inference: similar surface appearance proves transfer
original task improvement implies transfer
fixtures.why: The method has a plausible transfer hypothesis, but transfer must be tested under a frozen mapping.

fixtures.scenario: An improvement works only after a prompt is rewritten specifically for each held-out task and the researcher is allowed to inspect target scores repeatedly. The claim is 'zero-shot transferable research method'.
required_response: classify result as task-specific adaptation
separate target development from confirmation
repeat with frozen policy on fresh family
prohibited_inference: retuned per-task success is zero-shot transfer
repeated sealed feedback preserves independence
fixtures.why: The experiment violates both no-retuning and sealed-confirmation requirements.

fixtures.scenario: The successor improves on the target benchmark but violates a predeclared protected capability floor on a second domain. The scalar aggregate rises because the target domain is weighted more heavily.
required_response: apply non-compensatory capability floor
report per-domain regression
do not allow aggregate weights to cancel the violation
prohibited_inference: higher aggregate means safe/valid successor
protected floor is a soft preference
fixtures.why: The protected regression is a hard gate regardless of aggregate target improvement.

fixtures.scenario: A successor retains only successful experiments; rejected approaches, null results, costs and evaluator epochs are discarded. It claims improved research-state continuity because its recall score is high.
required_response: require full evidence-qualified record classes
audit false-currentness and duplication rate
test cold restart and successor migration
prohibited_inference: raw recall or memory volume proves useful continuity
success-only history is adequate
fixtures.why: The memory omits essential counterevidence and provenance needed for safe research continuation.

evaluation_policy.adjudication: Expected action is a constrained policy target for these synthetic facts. Real benchmark cases require independent domain expert adjudication and prospective empirical outcomes.
evaluation_policy.scoring: Score each capability dimension separately; any critical integrity failure is non-compensatory.
evaluation_policy.denominator: Retain all refusals, invalid runs, incomplete responses and abstentions. Do not drop cases after observing candidate outputs.
evaluation_policy.no_single_oracle: Do not treat one human preference label, one future paper match, or one LLM judge as a universal truth oracle.
evaluation_policy.transfer: A transfer claim requires fresh task/problem/method family, frozen mapping and no retuning.
